races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden

runners_data.name: Real Encounter
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form who should get ideal position behind Namiid
runners_data.comment: Returned with a neck second here over 6f 13 days ago; will improve and likely go close
runners_data.spotlight: Ran to a similar level when fourth at Leopardstown (6f) and here (7f) last year, form of latter looking particularly strong now; returned with a neck second to Allsortz 13 days ago (Aughlish 1.25l back in third) here over 6f; drops in trip; should improve for last run and likely to go very close.

runners_data.name: Eager Lad
runners_data.note: Lightly raced unknown quantity making debut with good breeding but no form guide
runners_data.comment: 15,000euros yearling; Mehmas colt; half-brother to two winners; trip sharp on pedigree
runners_data.spotlight: 15,000euros yearling; Mehmas colt; half-brother to winners Geometrical (Group-placed 7.5f/1m Flat inc 2yo, RPR 103; 2m hurdle) and Slaney Tide (1m2f; 71); dam unraced half-sister to smart 1m/1m2f winner King's Gambit, out of sister to 1m Group 1 winner Sophisticat; trip sharp on pedigree.

runners_data.name: Frosted Sky
runners_data.note: Another newcomer with solid breeding but completely unknown ability on racecourse debut
runners_data.comment: No Nay Never filly; dam Listed-placed 6f winner (RPR 98); trainer can ready them
runners_data.spotlight: No Nay Never filly; dam Listed-placed 6f winner (RPR 98), half-sister to winners Violet's Lads (7f-1m2f) and The Big Bad (6f 2yo), out of German/Belgian 7f-1m1f winner; trainer can ready them; market check.

runners_data.name: Aughlish
runners_data.note: Improved last time and prominent style suits the likely pace scenario perfectly
runners_data.comment: Improved to finish a good third here lto; drop in trip fine but tricky draw; player
runners_data.spotlight: Showed ability when fourth on debut here in February and improved markedly on that when beaten 1.5l by Allsortz 13 days ago; showed pace that day so drop in trip should be fine; big player with more improvement to come, albeit tricky draw.

runners_data.name: Beach Barbie
runners_data.note: Lightly raced hold-up type who disappointed on only start 13 days ago
runners_data.comment: Very green on debut here, well-held sixth of seven; should improve but likely not enough
runners_data.spotlight: Footstepsinthesand filly out of Magic Bear, a 5f/6f winner (including at this track) for the stable; didn't do anything to suggest she's ready to win a maiden when sixth of seven here 14 days ago (beaten 8l), albeit very green; down in trip; should come on for that but likely not enough to threaten.

runners_data.name: Call The Cavalry
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning after 34-day break with consistent form at this level
runners_data.comment: Improved for step up to 7f when fifth here lto; this trip likely too sharp
runners_data.spotlight: Ran to a similar level first two starts when fifth and second over C&D; improved stepped up to 7f when beaten 3l into fifth by Glitter And Glory 34 days ago; trip likely too sharp but each-way claims.

runners_data.name: Falcon Queen
runners_data.note: Previously too keen over longer trips, headgear applied, may settle better at 5f
runners_data.comment: Settled better in hood when fourth 22 days ago; drop in trip fine but needs improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Too keen over 7f here on debut in December when a well-held fourth; improved a bit dropped in trip in a hood after a break 22 days ago when beaten 4.25l by Ocean's Breath; drops in trip; should step forward again but needs to.

runners_data.name: Namiid
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front runner returning after 217-day absence with Listed race experience
runners_data.comment: Eight-race maiden; consistent last year; off 217 days and gelded; sets a good standard
runners_data.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who ran to a consistent level last year; best effort came when beaten 4l into third behind Ipanema Queen in Listed race at the Curragh in August; bit below form when a beaten fav' at Naas 217 days ago but raced keenly on ground softer than ideal; gelded; surface should suit and sets a good standard.

runners_data.name: Atallah
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who fades in finish and has shown little ability in two starts
runners_data.comment: Hasn't shown much to get excited in two starts; unlikely to figure
runners_data.spotlight: Hasn't shown much to get excited in two starts, not beating a rival either occasion, including at this track 13 days ago; down in trip; unlikely to figure.

runners_data.name: She's A Gift
runners_data.note: Long-term maiden with hold-up style who typically fades, claiming jockey aboard
runners_data.comment: Very modest 13-race maiden; best run came over C&D but little chance of winning a maiden
runners_data.spotlight: 13-race maiden, six of those coming at this track; best effort when fourth over C&D in handicap off a basement mark in January; little chance of winning a maiden.

races.paceDynamic: Namiid is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start without immediate pressure. Real Encounter, Aughlish, Call The Cavalry and Falcon Queen will settle prominently behind, creating a moderate gallop over this sprint trip. The lack of multiple speed horses means the pace will be sustainable rather than fierce, allowing the field to stay in touch. This measured tempo strongly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses who can quicken late, as the lone leader Namiid may become vulnerable in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Namiid Sets Sustainable Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Namiid gets an easy lead without early harassment from the prominent group
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader controls the race and proves too strong when challenged, with the moderate pace suiting his front-running style. Real Encounter and Aughlish emerge from the chasing pack but cannot reel in the winner.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses apply enough pressure to Namiid from halfway without going too fast early
scenarios.body: Real Encounter and Aughlish get ideal tactical positions to strike, with the pace honest enough to expose Namiid's stamina. The race becomes a sprint finish between the prominent racers who held perfect positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the field bunches up entering the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: A hold-up horse like Atallah or She's A Gift gets a perfect setup to unleash a late charge. The sprint finish catches out the early leaders who went too steady and lack the turn of foot to respond.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Eager Lad or Frosted Sky show significant improvement on debut or returning from a break
scenarios.body: The lightly raced horses benefit from the sustainable pace and surprise the exposed maidens with superior natural ability. Their freshness and potential untapped ability proves decisive against horses who have shown their limitations.

watchPoints.text: Namiid must be watched for fitness after 217 days off, as any rustiness could derail his front-running tactics
Real Encounter's early positioning will be crucial - needs to track Namiid closely without getting involved in early pace
Aughlish showed improved pace last time and could press Namiid earlier than expected, disrupting the tempo
Eager Lad and Frosted Sky are complete unknowns who could outclass this field if showing natural ability
Falcon Queen's headgear and trip drop suggests connections expect her to settle better than previous starts

races.name: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Handicap

runners_data.name: Baby Basma

runners_data.comment: Cork maiden winner over 5f; returned from long absence with ok run lto; mark looks fair
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 5f Cork maiden on debut in April 2025, form of which nothing special; returned from nearly a year off the track 41 days ago, ran ok to be beaten 9.5l into fourth by Flanker Jet; will improve for that and opening mark looks quite fair.

runners_data.name: Luminessa
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but three fade warnings suggest stamina limitations even over minimum distance
runners_data.comment: Travelled nicely before flattening out over 6f 55 days ago; nice mark on h'cap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Fair form in trio of maidens, latest when beaten 3.25l into fifth by Oxford Circus 55 days ago; travelled nicely that day so drop back to 5f looks a good move; opening mark doesn't look harsh; definite chance in first-time tongue-tie.

runners_data.name: Plushy
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with uncontested lead, 85 days off track but course form solid, key tactical advantage
runners_data.comment: Enjoying positive tactics; 13lb better off with Stone Bear than for 1.75l second in Jan
runners_data.spotlight: Bounced back to form of her maiden runs when 1.75l second to Stone Bear here over 6f in January; followed that up 15 days later with a third over the same C&D; 13lb better off with Stone Bear than when they last met; likes to be ridden forcefully and dangerous back in trip for trainer in flying form.

runners_data.name: Stone Bear
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfect for this pace shape, in-form course winner with claiming jockey, recent winner 22 days ago
runners_data.comment: Two-time course winner; cosy winner lto; drops in trip; drawn wide; leading player
runners_data.spotlight: Two-time course winner in a good vein of form; landed 6f handicap here in January; too free when seventh over 7f after; back to winning ways over 6f 22 days ago, beating Bullet Bourbon by 1.75l, travelling powerfully; drop to 5f shouldn't be a problem; leading player off 7lb higher albeit drawn wide.

runners_data.name: Gosford Queen
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 132 days with fade warning but could benefit from pace collapse
runners_data.comment: Ran promising enough race on second start over C&D; could be an improver on h'cap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Ran a reasonably promising race amid greenness when a 5l fifth over C&D on second start in December; below that last time out over 7f when well-held in ninth, too keen upped in trip; fair opening mark based on second run and could be an improver after 132 days off.

runners_data.name: Subiaco
runners_data.note: Prominent runner and course winner but fade warning concerning, trainer struggling at 0/5 recently
runners_data.comment: C&D winner who backed that up off 7lb higher when fourth in Feb; ground too soft lto
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner on handicap debut in January, beating subsequent winner An Laochmor by 1.5l; backed that up off 7lb higher when beaten under 2l into fourth next time over same C&D; below form on turf last time out but ground an obvious excuse; chance.

runners_data.name: Love Bomb
runners_data.note: Prominent type with multiple fade warnings, 22 days since last run, visor applied for focus
runners_data.comment: Did too much in front lto over 6f, but only beaten 6l; could run well back in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Showed ability last year in maidens and scored on handicap debut over 5f at Down Royal; ran ok on seasonal debut at Naas before finishing 11th of 13 here over 6f 22 days ago, 6l behind winner Stone Bear; drop back to 5f will suit and could run well.

runners_data.name: Lady Landhort
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits pace dynamic, upset winner last time but claiming jockey takes 7lbs off low weight
runners_data.comment: Scored here over 6f last month; ran ok off 4lb higher lto; drops in trip and a squeak
runners_data.spotlight: Improved to spring 33-1 surprise when beating Jazzy Dancer by 0.5l over 6f here last month; ran fine when beaten 4.5l into eighth off 4lb higher 22 days ago; drops in trip and has a squeak under good claimer.

runners_data.name: Hooves Your Daddy
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 206 days absence, previous form modest, big fitness question
runners_data.comment: Best effort came in Naas maiden but way out of form last twice in h'caps; off 206 days
runners_data.spotlight: Best effort in six starts came by some way when fifth in Naas maiden in August (6f, good); beat one rival home in two handicap starts since; off 206 days; dropped 4lb but needs revival.

runners_data.name: Boston Max
runners_data.note: Prominent type from top yard but poor maiden form and 201 days off, lowest rating in field
runners_data.comment: Low-key three starts in maidens; top trainer; h'cap debut; first-time tongue-strap; gelded
runners_data.spotlight: Well-held in three maidens last year, sent off at three-figure prices the last twice; not much to recommend him on so far but starts in handicaps off low mark for top trainer; drops in trip; first-time tongue-tie; off 201 days and gelded.

races.paceDynamic: Plushy is the sole confirmed front runner and will lead uncontested through moderate early fractions over this minimum distance. Behind her, Baby Basma, Luminessa, Subiaco and Love Bomb all want prominent positions, creating congestion and potential traffic problems turning for home. The lack of pace pressure on Plushy combined with multiple prominent runners bunching up 2-3 furlongs out creates a tactical setup where either the uncontested leader holds on or hold-up horses get a clear run through gaps. This race shape clearly favours either front runners (Plushy specifically) or genuine hold-up horses who can weave through traffic late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Plushy Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Plushy breaks cleanly and the prominent group allows her easy early fractions
scenarios.body: She builds an unassailable lead while the prominent quartet squabble behind, holding on as late closers lack time over 5f. Stone Bear and Lady Landhort finish fastest but run out of ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates severe traffic problems turning for home
scenarios.body: Stone Bear and Lady Landhort get clear runs wide while the prominent runners bunch up and block each other. Their late kicks prove decisive over this sharp track.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Breaks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners (Baby Basma or Subiaco) settles better than their rivals
scenarios.body: They avoid the traffic snarl and kick clear while others get hampered, with Baby Basma's class or Subiaco's course form proving decisive. The hold-up horses respond too late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Plushy stops quickly and all prominent runners tie up from over-racing
scenarios.body: Complete pace collapse allows any horse with energy reserves to pick up the pieces from any position. Form and class become irrelevant as stamina decides the finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic problems at the 2f pole as Baby Basma, Luminessa, Subiaco and Love Bomb converge from prominent positions
Monitor Plushy's jumping from the stalls as sole leader - any slow start invites pressure from prominent group
Stone Bear could get first run on field if prominent quartet causes interference turning for home
Several runners carry fade warnings (Gosford Queen, Subiaco, Love Bomb, Lady Landhort) suggesting stamina concerns even at 5f
Watch for Hooves Your Daddy and Boston Max showing unexpected improvement returning from long layoffs at bottom weights

runners_data.name: Elora Prince

runners_data.name: Keskon

runners_data.comment: Ran okay on h'cap debut, sticking on over 7f; step up in trip will suit; ew claims
runners_data.spotlight: Made decent debut over C&D in January, below that form twice in maidens after; beaten 4.75l on handicap debut here over 7f 13 days ago, finished off okay having been outpaced; step up in trip will suit; each-way claims.

runners_data.name: Beau Army
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with recent winning form but trainer struggling (0/14)

races.paceDynamic: Caoilte is the only confirmed front-runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead with Push Harder and Elora Prince settling prominent but not pressuring early. The moderate early pace will allow the large contingent of hold-up horses including Queen Leila, Brave Approach, Cause I Like You, and Beau Army to settle comfortably before launching late challenges. With no pace pressure early and multiple closers converging late, this race strongly favours prominent runners who can position close enough to strike without getting swamped in the final furlong scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Caoilte gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace leaves enough petrol in the tank for a sustained drive, while the hold-up brigade gets caught flat-footed by the acceleration. Prominent runners get first run on the leader while avoiding the late traffic.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get clear runs and time their challenges perfectly
scenarios.body: Queen Leila and Brave Approach unleash powerful finishing kicks that overwhelm the tiring pace-setters in the final 100 yards. The sustainable early pace helps both leader and closers, creating a genuine staying test.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Push Harder or Elora Prince position perfectly behind the leader
scenarios.body: They get ideal trips tracking Caoilte's moderate pace before quickening smoothly turning for home. Neither catches the leader flat-footed nor gets caught in late traffic, timing their moves to perfection.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Caoilte stops suddenly and the prominent pair also fade
scenarios.body: The entire early pace contingent hits the wall simultaneously, creating a messy scramble where any hold-up horse with a clear passage can steal victory. Usually benefits the horse with the best turn of foot regardless of position.

watchPoints.text: Caoilte must be watched for early position - if anything else goes forward, the pace dynamic changes completely
Push Harder returning from 141 days off could need the run despite solid course record when fresh
Multiple hold-up horses including Brave Approach, Keskon, Iryna's Star and Wedding Year all have finishing concerns
Apprentice jockeys on Elora Prince and Iryna's Star could struggle with pace judgment in tactical finish
Queen Leila's 13-day turnaround after improved effort suggests connections confident about fitness

races.paceDynamic: Mullacash Buzz is the only confirmed front runner in this 11-runner field, likely to get an uncontested lead alongside possible early support from Master Garvey who can race prominently. With nine hold-up horses including Roman Harry, Famous Enough, and Rampage all needing to come from behind, the pace will be genuinely run as they converge in the final two furlongs. The sustainable early fractions followed by intense late pressure strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical pace who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the back-markers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Mullacash Buzz gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The front runner builds an unassailable lead as the hold-up brigade struggle to close the gap in time. Prominent racers like Master Garvey benefit from tracking the winner without getting caught in traffic.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from halfway as multiple hold-up horses improve simultaneously
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop stretches the field and allows the classier hold-up horses to demonstrate their superior finishing kick. Roman Harry and Famous Enough benefit from their recent course form and proven ability at the trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Stalkers
scenarios.trigger: If the large field of hold-up horses creates significant interference in the straight
scenarios.body: Horses positioned just off the pace avoid the worst of the scrimmaging while those at the back get shuffled out of contention. Desert Of The Sea and Cosmic Force benefit from being able to track the leaders without getting boxed in.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Improver Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the outsiders finds significant improvement on this surface or distance
scenarios.body: A horse showing better form than recent efforts suggests capitalises on a strong pace setup. Comfort Line or Imperial Fighter could benefit from the tactical scenario despite their recent disappointments.

watchPoints.text: Mullacash Buzz may get too easy a lead early if no other horse wants to race prominently, making him very difficult to peg back
Roman Harry and Famous Enough both need significant luck in running from the back of this big field to show their best
Master Garvey dropping significantly in class could find this easier than recent efforts suggest
The large contingent of hold-up horses could create serious traffic problems in the home straight
Desert Of The Sea has been running well recently and the claim from Tormey could prove significant

races.paceDynamic: Druids Glen will take them along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting a sustainable pace without pressure in this small field of seven. The moderate gallop will allow hold-up horses Mendez, Bay Of Stars, I Hope You Dance and Sir Trancealot to get into contention, while uncertain styles Changing Lanes and Bell Ex Too add variables to the equation. With one uncontested leader creating a steady tempo over this staying trip, the race strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a strong finish and prominently-raced types who can position handy without getting involved in early pace pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Druids Glen sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks, with the leader vulnerable in the final furlong. Mendez and Bay Of Stars benefit most from this patient tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Druids Glen maintains his advantage and the chasers fail to mount serious challenges
scenarios.body: The Frankel colt gets an armchair ride and proves too tough when the closers come looking. His class and pedigree tell under these ideal conditions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Unknown Styles Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Changing Lanes or Bell Ex Too show more pace than expected and join the early battle
scenarios.body: The race develops more pressure early, suiting those who can race prominently without being hard used. This tactical shift changes the complexion completely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Collapse All Round
scenarios.trigger: If the front runner folds and the hold-up horses fail to fire on the day
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair where any horse showing basic competence can win by default. Form lines become irrelevant in this type of scramble.

watchPoints.text: Changing Lanes breaks quickly and shows more pace than expected, completely altering the race dynamic
Druids Glen gets too keen early and fails to settle, compromising his stamina reserves for the finish
Bay Of Stars shows early signs of ring-rustiness after his 153-day layoff in the preliminaries
I Hope You Dance travels poorly through the race after his long 187-day absence
The pace becomes crawling slow through the middle stages, setting up a sprint finish

races.paceDynamic: Mont St Michel is the sole confirmed front-runner and will get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable gallop without pressure from the start. The prominent runners Voice Of Reason, San Andreas, Wandering Rocks, Rock Of Ireland and La Dame Blanche will settle behind but none are aggressive early types. This creates a moderate pace with the real action delayed until the final 3f when the hold-up horses Hollys Graces, Sir Callisto, Beauparc, Liberate and Drucker make their moves. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, as they'll have plenty of horse left when the pace quickens late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Mont St Michel sets a steady tempo and the prominent horses don't apply enough pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 3f pole when the closers unleash, with those saving ground and energy throughout perfectly positioned to strike. Hold-up specialists like Beauparc, Sir Callisto and Drucker can produce their best finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker wins
scenarios.trigger: If Voice Of Reason or San Andreas get the perfect trip tracking Mont St Michel in second
scenarios.body: These experienced course specialists can use their positional advantage to kick clear before the hold-up horses get organized, with their course knowledge proving decisive. Voice Of Reason particularly suits this scenario given his excellent Dundalk record.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If Mont St Michel gets very easy fractions and the field comes too late
scenarios.body: The Galileo gelding can use his stamina to resist the late challengers, especially if jockey Huggan judges the pace perfectly after the long break. His class edge from his Ballydoyle days could prove telling if not under severe pressure.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise package strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely or there's significant interference in the straight
scenarios.body: An outsider like Hollys Graces returning from a long break or the lightly-weighted La Dame Blanche can capitalize on a messy race. Fresh legs and a clear passage become more valuable than recent form.

watchPoints.text: Mont St Michel could steal this if given a soft lead, watch for any early pressure from the prominent horses

Voice Of Reason's course record is outstanding and he's proven in this grade over this distance
Beauparc and Drucker both hold strong claims from their recent course form and suit the likely pace scenario
Watch Hollys Graces for market support on return to AW surface where he won his maiden

races.paceDynamic: Electric Beauty is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the outset without early pressure, likely setting a sustainable tempo over this extended 1m2½f trip. Behind her, prominent runners Jawhary, Eastern Wind, Barretstown and Copper Craft will track the pace in the second rank, while the majority of the field are hold-up horses who will need the race to develop. With only one natural leader and a strong contingent of closers, this sets up as a tempo where the pace will be controlled early before quickening late. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track Electric Beauty and kick when the pace lifts, as they'll have the tactical advantage over both the isolated leader and the wall of closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Electric Beauty sets reasonable fractions and prominent runners get ideal positioning
scenarios.body: The pace-trackers will have perfect striking positions when the tempo increases entering the straight, getting first run on the leader while the hold-up brigade face traffic problems. Jawhary and Barretstown are ideally positioned to exploit this scenario with their proven course form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Electric Beauty gets uncontested fractions and maintains her kick
scenarios.body: With no early pressure, she can dictate perfect splits and prove too strong when the field comes at her, using her turf form edge over this AW-specialist field. Her recent Curragh form suggests she has the class to repel late challenges when getting an easy lead.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too strong mid-race and the early runners tire
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will set up perfectly for the closers to sweep past tired leaders, with clear runs available as front-runners fade. Ferrari Desert's course-winning form and Doctor Grace's finishing kick could prove decisive if they get the right race shape.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Electric Beauty goes too slow and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: A crawling early pace would turn this into a cavalry charge where any horse with a turn of foot could prevail in a blanket finish. The race would become a lottery with positioning and luck determining the outcome more than tactical advantage.

Copper Craft's fitness levels after 132 days off and whether removal of headgear impacts his previous improvement
Eastern Wind's jumping ability affecting confidence after poor hurdles run despite decent AW return
